mapper.select: select (doc->'org'->'cpl')::text p from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select coalesce(sum(secs), 0) from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'beat' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
select count(*)::int from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'attend' and cls = #{cls} and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
select extract(epoch from now() - max(at))::float8 from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'beat'
select x::text c, (doc->'org'->'cpl')::text p from tenant_state, jsonb_array_elements(doc->'classes') x where tenant_id = #{tid} and x->>'id' = #{cls} limit 1

select id, qorder::text qorder, (extract(epoch from ends_at) * 1000)::bigint ends_ms from cpl_exam where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and cls = #{cls} and item = #{item} and submitted_at is null order by started_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update cpl_exam set submitted_at = now(), score = 0, pass = false, late = true where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select coalesce(score, 0) from cpl_exam where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and cls = #{cls} and item = #{item} and submitted_at is not null
mapper.insert: insert into cpl_exam (id, tenant_id, sid, cls, item, qorder, ends_at) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{sid}, #{cls}, #{item}, cast(#{order} as jsonb), case when cast(#{ends} as bigint) is null then null else to_timestamp(cast(#{ends} as bigint) / 1000.0) end)
mapper.select: select id, cls, item, qorder::text qorder, (extract(epoch from ends_at) * 1000)::bigint ends_ms from cpl_exam where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and submitted_at is null
mapper.update: update cpl_exam set submitted_at = now(), answers = cast(#{answers} as jsonb), score = #{score}, pass = #{pass}, late = #{late} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select sid, cls, item, answers::text answers from cpl_exam where tenant_id = #{tid} and submitted_at is not null order by sid, id limit 5000
select sid, pw_hash from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}

select 1 from tenant_state, jsonb_array_elements(doc->'members') m, jsonb_array_elements(doc->'classes') x where tenant_id = #{tid} and m->>'sid' = #{sid} and x->>'id' = #{cls} and jsonb_exists(x->'drop', m->>'id') limit 1
select 1 from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind in ('verify-phone', 'review') and at > now() - interval '15 minutes' limit 1
mapper.update: update learners set pw_hash = #{hash} where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.select: select sid, cls, item, score, pass, late, to_char(submitted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') at from cpl_exam where tenant_id = #{tid} and submitted_at is not null order by submitted_at desc limit 2000
select distinct item from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'beat' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
mapper.insert: insert into cpl_log (tenant_id, sid, kind, cls, item, secs, ip, ua, eval_cd, chasi) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, #{kind}, #{cls}, #{item}, #{secs}, #{ip}, #{ua}, #{evalCd}, #{chasi})
mapper.select: select sid, coalesce(sum(secs) filter (where kind = 'beat'), 0)::int secs, coalesce(sum(secs) filter (where kind = 'beat' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date), 0)::int today, count(distinct ip)::int ips, to_char(max(at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') last, (count(*) filter (where kind like 'verify-%'))::int verified from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} group by sid order by max(at) desc limit 1000

select id::text id, sid, kind, cls, item, secs, ip, ua, eval_cd, chasi, to_char(at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') at from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and (#{sid} = '' or sid = #{sid}) order by cpl_log.id desc limit #{n}
mapper.delete: delete from learner_sessions where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and id <> #{keep}
